title: Ligue 1 assists, 2025/26
brief: Name the ten players with the most Ligue 1 assists in 2025/26.

notes.Florian Thauvin: Thauvin is just outside with 6 assists.
notes.Santiago Hidalgo: Hidalgo is just outside with 6 assists.
notes.Julio Enciso: Enciso is just outside with 6 assists.
notes.Guela Doue: Guela Doue is just outside with 6 assists.
notes.Desire Doue: Desire Doue is just outside with 6 assists on Transfermarkt.
notes.Mousa Al-Tamari: Al-Tamari has 9 assists on Transfermarkt but 6 on ESPN.
notes.Arsene Kouassi: Kouassi has 8 assists on Transfermarkt but 6 on ESPN.

checks: Transfermarkt club season pages against ESPN's 2025/26 assists leaders. Assist counting differs between the two. The nine named slots are in the top ten (with ties) on both. The 10th slot is a pool of the five players who are in the top ten on both counts: on Transfermarkt they have 7 to 9, on ESPN 6 (joint 10th there with Thauvin, Hidalgo, Enciso and Guela Doue, who have 6 on Transfermarkt and are outside its top ten). Treat this board as less firm than the goals boards.
